applicant.organisation: Österreichische Gesundheitskasse (public health insurer), care management

purpose: We plan to expand our disease management programme 'Therapie Aktiv' for diabetes. Contributions and premiums are not affected; we need prevalence per region to plan enrolment capacity.
question: How many adults have type 2 diabetes, per region?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Type 2 diabetes = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E11.
Report per region: adults with type 2 diabetes.
